mentions.name: Music sheet photo-to-MIDI app
mentions.description: This mobile app takes photos of sheet music and converts them into a local document that can be played back as MIDI, performing all processing on the phone without any subscription. Existing sheet music apps charge $50+ yearly subscriptions, so this aims to work entirely with pure local phone processing. It is still in proof-of-concept phase.
mentions.problem: Existing sheet music apps all require expensive yearly subscriptions ($50+), with app store lockouts and platform promotion tied to the subscription fees.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a music sheet app that takes photos and turns it into a local doc you can play midi on, plenty exist but they all want subscriptions to use them. Trying to see if I can do it with pure local phone processing. Still in PoC Phase.
